testcase.name: the cells meet with no gap and no overlap
a finger that slid off its control lands on a different answer, which is not a launch either
the far corners still land on a control rather than on nothing
the strip scales with the tile, so a wide tile has wider targets
a tile with no size yet claims nothing
a two-control strip splits in half
the strip is the bottom third of the tile
a touch outside the tile is not a control
cell left edges follow the same arithmetic the strip is drawn with
each control owns its own third of the strip
a touch on the album art at the very top is not a control
a tile with no controls never claims a touch
a touch above the strip belongs to the tile, and therefore launches
